items.title: Barclays Sees Picky Bond Buyers Keeping Yields at Multiyear Peak
items.description: A shift in the buyer base of US Treasuries toward value-oriented mutual funds, households and other private investors has helped propel 30-year yields to multi-decade peaks, according to Barclays Plc.

items.title: A Solar Eclipse Will Flip the Off Switch on Europe’s Solar Farms
items.description: Night will fall on Europe’s power system a bit early Wednesday evening, as an eclipse is set to block solar generation across parts of the UK and western Europe.

items.title: JBS Seeks US Margin Recovery With New CEO Pledging Continuity
items.description: JBS NV said its main business of US beef is yet to benefit from a restructuring plan, but sees that effort as well as a renewed flow of Mexican cattle eventually aiding meatpacking margins.
